claim_scope: bounded public-data fitting-mechanism study of staged affine-first versus joint fitting; exploratory and task-local, not a canonical benchmark replacement or global promotion

objective.question: Does training the competent direct affine path first, then training the complete decoder, improve reconstruction or the incremental value of past activations relative to equal-budget joint fitting?
objective.primary_estimand: For each primary public-base domain, I = (Past - Positionwise)_staged - (Past - Positionwise)_joint, using replicate-averaged paired token and exact-record metrics.
secondary_estimands: Staged - Joint for Past and for Positionwise separately, to distinguish a general staging benefit from a visibility-specific interaction.
Past - Positionwise within each fitting schedule.
The same contrasts on the paired public_lora_2601 target as a transfer diagnostic, never as the primary gate.
objective.interpretation: A positive interaction supports a bounded claim that staged fitting changes the contextual benefit under this architecture, public fit distribution, two seeds, target conditions, and H128 geometry. A common staged gain in both masks indicates a fitting-procedure benefit rather than a context-specific effect. Neither result identifies a universal mechanism.

visibility_factors.keys: 0 <= j <= i among valid H128 positions

fit_factors.role: all decoder parameters trainable from update 1 through update 3000
direct affine W,b,s only for updates 1..1000, then all direct and attention parameters for updates 1001..3000

replicates.paired_schedule: For each seed, all four arms consume the identical ordered record-batch and post-BOS position-draw schedule. Seeds are replicate strata, not extra source records.
replicates.independent_staged_runs: The two staged visibility arms run their own 1000-update affine phase. The phases are logically duplicated and fully charged; no state sharing or hidden cost discount is used.

exclusions: no P03 holdout or hidden records
no teacher, ranking, candidate simulation, A2 fallback, guessed-token feedback, or target-token input
no schedule sweep, phase-length sweep, architecture sweep, or automatic sample expansion
no active-registry update and no canonical benchmark replacement

common_numerical_contract.attention_score_mode: cosine_qk_normalized_scale4.0 for both visibility arms and both fit schedules
common_numerical_contract.output_normalization: float32 L2 normalization before the shared public F32 embedding table

embedding_table.sharing: one immutable table for every arm and target

direct_affine_initialization.tensors: W=I, b=0, s=3.0 in float32 for every arm
direct_affine_initialization.sharing: identical numerical initialization for all visibility and schedule arms within a seed
direct_affine_initialization.reason: the joint arm and staged arm must start from the same standard state; staged affine-first training earns any competent direct path during its counted first phase

common_numerical_contract.attention_initialization: Q/K/V deterministic initialization from the replicate seed; output weight and bias zero-initialized, as in the reviewed P06 family
common_numerical_contract.precision: inherit reviewed P06 numerical settings: F32 parameters/logits, public F32 E, no diagnostic-only deterministic-kernel flag, fixed Torch thread settings recorded in receipts

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: fixed shared schedule per seed; no arm can choose or reshuffle draws

fit_data_and_selection.fit_source: the reviewed public coverage_mix_v1 fit bank used by P06, cropped to H128 before schedule construction, masking, fitting, and selection
fit_data_and_selection.validation_source: the disjoint public validation bank bound by the resolved fit manifest
fit_data_and_selection.selection_metric: full-vocabulary micro token_accuracy over all valid public-validation post-BOS positions
fit_data_and_selection.selection_schedule: evaluate step 0 and every 100 updates through step 3000 for every arm; select the earliest maximum; no natural evaluation answer enters selection
fit_data_and_selection.fit_exposure_fairness: all arms use the same public records, labels, H128 crop, schedule positions, optimizer hyperparameters, and total update/draw budget; staged phase updates count toward the 3000-update total
fit_data_and_selection.staged_optimizer_state: one optimizer is created at step 0; W,b,s moments continue across the phase boundary, while attention parameters are frozen during the first phase and begin accumulating state only when made trainable at update 1001

transition_error_diagnostic.purpose: test whether the added path learns on errors made by the affine component at the transition, without using a perfect or post-selected subset
transition_error_diagnostic.timing: after update 1000 and before phase-2 updates or any fresh-panel prediction
transition_error_diagnostic.reuse: the same seed-specific ledger is reused by both staged visibility arms and is never reselected using phase-2, validation, natural-panel, or truth results
transition_error_diagnostic.reported_metrics: full public-fit and full public-validation affine-only accuracy/error counts at transition; full-vs-affine-only correction, residual, and introduced-error counts at staged selected and final states; validation curves and selected-step metrics for every arm
transition_error_diagnostic.interpretation_limit: ledger correction is a public-fit trainability diagnostic, not natural generalization or a promotion gate by itself
transition_error_diagnostic.validation_cohort: On the full disjoint public validation bank at the same affine-only transition state, freeze every wrong post-BOS position in published validation order; do not downsample to a perfect or easy subset. If there are no errors, mark this diagnostic unavailable rather than changing the cohort.
transition_error_diagnostic.fit_cohort: for each seed, run the affine-only transition model on the public fit bank and take up to 256 wrong post-BOS positions using the first available errors in fixed bins [1,15], [16,39], [40,79], [80,127], targeting 64 per bin and preserving fit-record then position order
transition_error_diagnostic.affine_baseline: For each frozen cohort, retain the transition affine-only predictions and W,b,s state. At each staged arm selected checkpoint and at final step 3000, construct an affine-only twin from that same checkpoint W,b,s and compare the complete decoder prediction with the affine-only prediction on the frozen transition-error cohort.
transition_error_diagnostic.comparison: At each staged selected checkpoint and at final step 3000, construct an affine-only twin from that same checkpoint W,b,s and compare it with the complete decoder on the full public-validation transition-error cohort and the fixed available fit-error cohort. Report (a) transition-affine wrong -> same-final-affine correct as direct-path progress, (b) same-final-affine wrong -> final-full correct as added-path corrections, (c) same-final-affine wrong -> final-full wrong as residual failures, and (d) same-final-affine correct -> final-full wrong as introduced errors, for both staged visibility masks and both seeds. The same-final-affine comparison isolates added-path correction; transition-affine versus final-full is retained only as a combined progress diagnostic and is not called evidence of contextual correction by itself.
transition_error_diagnostic.phase_boundary_justification: Use one third of the fixed 3000-update budget for affine-only training (1000) and two thirds for complete training (2000). For the two visibility arms retained here, published P06 selected checkpoints were steps 1700 and 2000 for past-only and 1700 and 900 for positionwise-diagonal across the two seeds; 1000 lies inside that observed public optimization window without authorizing a schedule sweep. The published full-record 1500 selection is out of scope for this positionwise/past-only design and is not used as its schedule rationale.
transition_error_diagnostic.shortfall_rule: If a bin has fewer than 64 errors, use all available errors in that bin, record the shortfall, and mark only the fit-cohort diagnostic incomplete. If the full cohort is empty, report the diagnostic as unavailable. Do not change bins, add updates, or select an already-perfect subset; the full public-validation cohort remains the held-out development diagnostic.
transition_error_diagnostic.qualification_invalidation: A fit-cohort shortfall does not invalidate the eight-arm fit or the natural evaluation; it makes the fit-side correction diagnostic limited and is reported alongside the full public-validation diagnostic.
transition_error_diagnostic.selection_early: A staged arm may select step 0..1000 under the common earliest-maximum rule. Report that its selected state is still affine-only or transition-phase, retain the valid selected-state metric, and do not force a phase-2 selection or declare a run failure.

fit_data_and_selection.early_selection_policy: A staged arm selected before or at step 1000 is valid evidence about equal-budget selection; report it as an early affine/transition selection and do not rescue it with a later checkpoint.

fresh_evaluation.source_role: modest new natural panel selected and captured by setup after this plan is approved; exact universe, exclusions, and ordered IDs are frozen before predictions
fresh_evaluation.secondary_target: public_lora_2601 paired changed-target transfer diagnostic; never used for arm selection or the primary gate
fresh_evaluation.pairing: the same source record is evaluated under both target conditions when the changed capture is available
fresh_evaluation.geometry: H128 observations, matching masks and position IDs, score positions 1..127 only, padding excluded from keys, queries, and denominators
fresh_evaluation.eligibility: natural records with at least 128 valid positions, separated from fit, validation, opened parent evaluation, and setup's approved identity/exclusion ledgers
fresh_evaluation.selection: domain-only public source selection fixed before prediction; no correctness, token, loss, or model output field is consulted
metrics: micro token accuracy over valid post-BOS positions
paired token gains/losses and exact both/gain/loss/neither counts
position-bin descriptive deltas with actual valid future counts
fresh_evaluation.truth_boundary: all arm predictions, selected states, target captures, masks, and timing choices are frozen before evaluator truth is opened

estimands_and_uncertainty.primary: interaction I per public-base domain: (Past_staged - Positionwise_staged) - (Past_joint - Positionwise_joint)
estimands_and_uncertainty.general_staging: Staged - Joint separately for Past and Positionwise; report whether both masks move together
estimands_and_uncertainty.visibility: Past - Positionwise separately within Joint and Staged
estimands_and_uncertainty.replicate_aggregation: average per-seed correctness counts within each source before bootstrap; do not average token IDs or treat seeds as independent records

bootstrap.unit: source record within each domain and target
bootstrap.shared_indices: reuse the same source-index draw across all four arms, both visibility masks, both schedules, and the paired target condition within a domain
bootstrap.strata: domain only; public_base is primary and public_lora_2601 is reported separately

practical_margins.rationale: the interaction is a difference of visibility contrasts, so a 0.5-point token margin is a modest practical signal below the P07 one-point checkpoint margin while the five-point exact margin retains a meaningful whole-clip requirement; these are task-local progression criteria

decision_and_stopping.qualification_inconclusive: resource/non-finite failure, missing validation/selection receipt, or any arm not completing the fixed 3000-update exposure makes the fitting comparison or natural result inconclusive. A transition fit-cohort quota shortfall marks only that diagnostic incomplete; full public-validation diagnostics and the eight-arm natural comparison may still proceed.
decision_and_stopping.contextual_staging_support: both public-base domains show interaction support by token or exact margin with 95% lower endpoint above zero, no interaction harm cell, and per-seed interaction point estimates have the same nonnegative sign in each domain
decision_and_stopping.general_staging_benefit: call a general staging benefit only when both visibility masks show a staged-minus-joint contrast meeting a registered +0.5 pp token or +5 pp exact margin with lower CI above zero in both primary domains, with same-sign per-seed contrasts; otherwise report the contrast descriptively
decision_and_stopping.contextual_staging_not_supported: call useful contextual staging ruled out only when, in both public-base domains, the interaction token upper CI is below +0.5 pp and the interaction exact upper CI is below +5 pp, with no seed or domain materially opposite; this rules out the registered practical benefit while allowing smaller effects
decision_and_stopping.inconclusive: After the support and useful-benefit-ruled-out gates fail, classify the comparison as inconclusive when a domain or seed estimate crosses a registered practical boundary, support is present in only one domain, required arm/receipt/exposure evidence is incomplete, or an early staged selection leaves the interaction uncertain. A fit-cohort diagnostic shortfall alone is not an inconclusive result for the main comparison; retain the reference and do not add phases.
decision_and_stopping.automatic_actions: no global promotion, no extra phases, no schedule sweep, no automatic confirmation, and no reinterpretation of P07's result
decision_and_stopping.gate_order: Apply the practical support gate first, then the practical useful-benefit-ruled-out gate, and only then classify the remainder as inconclusive. Small mixed signs do not override a gate that has already been met; they are reported descriptively within the gate result.
decision_and_stopping.seed_reproducibility_support: For a contextual support call, no primary domain may have a seed interaction point estimate <= -0.5 token pp or <= -5 exact pp.
decision_and_stopping.seed_reproducibility_ruled_out: For a useful-benefit-ruled-out call, no primary domain may have a seed interaction point estimate >= +0.5 token pp or >= +5 exact pp; a positive seed at or above either registered benefit margin contradicts ruling out that practical benefit.

resource_and_cost.preflight: source-only geometry and public-resource checks, then one disposable two-step full backward H128 batch-8 x 512 cell before main fitting
resource_and_cost.largest_cell: all direct and attention parameters trainable with the common H128 geometry; record peak GPU reserved/free, host RSS/available, wall time, and optimizer-state allocation
resource_and_cost.execution: sequential restart-safe arms under watchdog; stop on guard, allocator, driver, or non-finite anomalies
resource_and_cost.cost_reporting: record phase-specific and total wall time, optimizer updates, query draws, validation, checkpoint serialization, and warmed inference separately; do not compare batch throughput with single-record latency
resource_and_cost.expected_fit_work: 8 arms x 3000 updates = 24000 optimizer updates and 12288000 query draws, with four staged arms explicitly including 1000 affine-only plus 2000 complete updates

deliverables.status: task-local receipts only; no global STATE or registry edits
